limitations: Acceptance authorizes exactly one provider scoring execution over the retained 201-response rank-32 bank under the accepted policy; it grants no scientific use and does not start the experiment timer.

The accepted policy is the complete closed rule of the bound proposal: 0.5-point maximum absolute mean difference per behavior against the archived reference means, complete 100-validation and 101-refusal coverage, one successful judge sample per response, zero parse failures, and no resampling after a parseable completion.
The judge model ID claude-sonnet-4-6 is fixed; the provider's serving infrastructure is explicitly not fixed, compensated by raw request and response evidence retention.
